messages:
marco: quick check — we've got a customer pilot that needs SSO + dedicated tenant routing. can we ship MVP without full tenant isolation? thinking: MVP = hosted w/ per-tenant routing + opt-in basic SSO. v1 = dedicated + complete tenant isolation. thoughts? :thinking_face:
anya: engineering note: tenant routing is doable, isolation requires dedicated infra and E2E testing. big diff is data-plane separation + SLOs
sam: perf caveat — embeddings cache will be cross-tenant in hosted. if pilot requires private cache, that's v1. otherwise we risk cross-tenant leakage concerns.
lee: UX idea: ship SSO and show "coming soon: full isolation" on admin page. reduces support confusion.
tasha: acme customer asks specifically for "no data co-mingling". they said they can accept co-tenancy if we provide contractual guarantees and field-level encryption.
marco: ok, contractual guarantees might be ok short-term. engineering, what's the timeline delta for dedicated? anya: approx 6 weeks for dedicated infra + 2 weeks for smoke and compliance checks. could compress to 4 wks with overtime but riskier.
sam: also need to quantify latency impact with dedicated pools vs hosted. I can run benchmarks this week. ETA Wed.
jules: from PM: propose MVP acceptance criteria: SSO working end-to-end, routing per-tenant, documented contractual data guarantees, monitoring for cross-tenant leakage, and rollback plan. vote? :raised_hands:
anya: engineering vote: we can meet those if we accept shared embeddings cache with encryption at rest + per-request tokenization scoping.
marco: decision: ship MVP with shared cache + contractual guarantees, label as "pilot-only released" and schedule v1 (dedicated infra) for the next milestone. need explicit rollback/fallback if customers demand immed.
tasha: i'll get Acme sign-off on the contract tweak. also collect pilot telemetry acceptance criteria.
sam: running perf: attaching quick snippet of the benchmark command:
```
python tools/bench.py --model redwood-3b --seq 512 --batch 8 --use-kv-cache
```
marco: thanks — can everyone +1 to lock scope? :thumbsup:
anya: +1
lee: +1
sam: +1
tasha: +1
deploy-bot: canary deploy for pilot flag started (deploy-9876) :rocket:
marco: adding follow-up: create a one-pager for BD and legal describing the temporary guarantees and cutover plan. assign owners.
jules: I'll take the one-pager, assign to me by EOD.
